title: Portrait Drawing Fundamentals
desc: Learn to observe proportion, build facial structure, and render expressive portraits through a guided series of drawing studies.

title: Color Theory for Painters
desc: Understand hue, value, temperature, and harmony, then apply those principles to make more deliberate choices in your paintings.

title: One on One Mentorship
desc: A focused monthly practice with individual feedback, clear creative goals, and guidance shaped around your work.

title: Charcoal and Texture
desc: Explore mark-making, tonal range, and material studies to bring depth and tactile character to charcoal drawings.

title: Building Your Portfolio
desc: Shape a coherent portfolio, select and sequence your strongest work, and present your practice with confidence.

title: Figure and Gesture
desc: Develop a quicker eye for movement and proportion with structured gesture sessions and practical figure studies.
